items.organizationName: Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Industrial Control Systems (ICS)
items.scope: Vulnerabilities that are (1) reported to or observed by CISA, (2) affect industrial control systems or medical devices, and (3) are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Genetec products and solutions only.
Vulnerabilities identified in Wiz products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Wiz that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Kaspersky B2C and B2B products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered in third-party software not in another CNA’s scope.
Bosch products only.

items.organizationName: Monash University - Cyber Security Incident Response Team
items.scope: Vulnerabilities in any Monash University developed products, or vulnerabilities identified in third-party vendor products used by Monash University, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All Ribose products and services, including open source projects, supported products, and end-of-life/end-of-service products.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
Foxit issues only.
Products and projects covered by its bug bounty programs that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Projects within The Document Foundation only, e.g., LibreOffice, LibreOffice Online; The Document Foundation discourages reporting denial of service bugs as security issues.
Forcepoint products only.
All Esri products only, including ArcGIS.
Digi branded products and services only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by researchers in collaboration with Maritime Hacking Village that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by Project Black that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered in Extreme Networks, Inc.’s products and services.

Vulnerabilities that are discovered, validated, and coordinated through the Hackrate Ethical Hacking Platform, including: software, web applications, APIs, and cloud services; vulnerabilities validated and triaged by our internal security team; and findings disclosed under our coordination that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Dragos products and third-party products it researches related to operational technology (OT)/industrial control systems (ICS) not covered by another CNA.
Omron Group companies’ Industrial Automation, Healthcare, Social Systems, Device & Module Solutions issues only.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
Open Design Alliance products only.
Check Point Security Gateways product line only, and any vulnerabilities discovered by Check Point that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
Johnson Controls products only.
Zscaler issues only.
Vulnerabilities in GeoVision products only.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.
Radiometer products only.
All Gallagher security products only.
Zephyr project components, and vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
N-able branded products and technologies only.
All Snow Software products.
All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and ProLeiT.
Vivo issues only.
Western Digital products including WD, SanDisk, SanDisk Professional, G-Technology, and HGST only.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
Supported Secomea products only.
SoftIron HyperCloud branded products and technologies only.
All products of 2N Telekomunikace a.s. including end-of-life/end-of-service products.
Gridware software, services, and infrastructure issues, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to Gridware researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Jamf issues and Jamf Open Source.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
All HYPR products only.
Synaptics issues only.
Third-party products he researches that are not in another CNA’s scope.
